summary.storyTitle: Story 5: Detach Sources and Preserve Prior Provenance
summary.implementedScope: Resolved SV-05-01 by reusing a shared active-process-source resolver for future runtime planning so detached attachments are excluded from start/resume hydration plans, rehydrate/rebuild plans, and checkpoint source selection, while detach alone still leaves an already-hydrated working copy plan untouched until a new runtime planning request is made.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead could not accept the story because 3 acceptance check(s) remain incomplete.

evidence: Verifier 009 marks SV-05-01 resolved.

Verifier 009 states the shared active-source resolver now excludes detached rows and is applied to materials reads, start/resume hydration planning, rehydrate/rebuild planning, and checkpoint source selection.
Verifier 009 reports no new findings and no open findings.

changedFiles.reason: Added a shared resolver for active process sources that excludes detached rows and preserves process-scope shadowing.
Switched process current-source rendering to the shared active-source resolver.
Filtered detached source IDs out of future hydration and checkpoint planning paths.
Updated start-time hydration planning to exclude detached sources from new working-set plans.
Updated resume-time hydration planning to exclude detached sources from new working-set plans.
Expanded Story 5 runtime coverage for no mid-run rewrite, detached-source-free rehydrate/rebuild plans, and detached-source checkpoint blocking.
Seeded current source refs explicitly so live checkpoint/provenance tests continue to match active-source resolver semantics.
Seeded source attachments/current refs explicitly for hydration-plan assertions under the active-source resolver rules.
